description: The comprehension->analysis process as a GOAL-DRIVEN GRAPH FIXPOINT. read_and_comprehend's ~10 hand-sequenced Python faculty calls + produce_analysis's section marshalling are DELETED; each faculty is a STAGE fired by its OWN graph precondition (this seed's la_dispatch_* rules), and the run_rules fixpoint sequences them by data-dependency. The analysis_advance Reflex (a dispatched AnalysisStage exists) runs the stage's thin non-branching Python executor (domains/reading_drive.py's _advance_dispatched_stage), exactly the _question_pursue_advance precedent. Stages, the report Goal + the Source are minted per-drive by the thin adapter (reading_drive.run_reading_flow); the rules/reflex are the static graph-resident sequencer. || ASYNC ORDER-N (v1.1.0, 2026-07-07): the FIRST-PASS stages (spine + the situation-model build: infer_goal/discourse/infer_causal/enabling/centrality/tom) keep their ordered, one-shot dispatch (each fires once when its data-precondition holds, in order). The ORDER-N collapses (narrative arc, trope/theme, executive monitoring) are made ASYNC + REVISABLE: their dispatch rules are MATERIAL-triggered (no prior-stage-`done` latch) and new la_rearm_* rules re-arm them (done -> pending) when their input-node set GROWS or a coherence break flags a GlobalIncoherence -- the exact sd_redecode/codebook_epoch re-arm-on-growth mechanism, mirrored for the reading. The reading now streams the first pass in order while the higher-order recognitions hover async, re-collapsing on their own material triggers over ticks. || FLOW-SCOPED REARM (v1.2.0, Wave 1A, 2026-07-10): on a PERSISTENT substrate (many successive `run_reading_flow` calls, different texts), the la_rearm_* rules' epoch Count()s were GLOBAL (Count(SmEvent)/Count(NarrativeRole)/Count(GlobalIncoherence)/Count(SmEntity) over the WHOLE substrate), so a LATER flow's own growth could re-arm and SUPERSEDE an EARLIER, already-returned flow's narrative/trope/monitoring stage (deleting its Trope/NarrativeRole/Claim nodes). Each Count is now `Count(Filter(NodesOfType(T), fx, Eq(Attr(fx,'unit'), Attr(stage,'flow'))))` -- scoped to the REARMING STAGE's own flow (the `flow` attr `reading_drive._mint_stages` stamps on every AnalysisStage, matched against `unit`, the SAME per-flow identity `ce.read_into_situation_model`/`dc.read_discourse`/`ns.recognize_narrative_structure`/`tt.recognize_tropes_and_theme` now stamp when called with `unit=ad.flow`). A single-flow substrate is byte-identical (every node shares one flow/unit value, so the Filter is a no-op).

rules.name: la_dispatch_narrative
rules.comment: ASYNC ORDER-N (2026-07-07): the narrative arc collapse is MATERIAL-TRIGGERED, not gated behind a fixed prior-stage-`done` latch. It fires the moment its READ material EXISTS -- SmEvents (events -> arc) AND an EnablingChain backbone (which transitively guarantees infer_goal/infer_causal/discourse already ran, since enabling depends on those, so the arc sees complete inputs). The old 4 stage-done Exists gates (enabling/centrality/discourse/infer_goal done) are REPLACED by this single EnablingChain material gate. Revisability comes from la_rearm_narrative (mirrors sd_redecode): re-arm when the SmEvent set GROWS since the last collapse or a coherence break flags a GlobalIncoherence -- so the arc re-collapses over accumulating material rather than being computed once at the end.

rules.name: la_dispatch_trope
rules.comment: ASYNC ORDER-N (2026-07-07): trope/theme recognition is MATERIAL-TRIGGERED off the arc it reads -- it fires the moment a NarrativeRole exists (arc -> trope), NOT gated behind a fixed 'narrative done' latch. Revised by la_rearm_trope (mirrors sd_redecode): re-arm when the NarrativeRole set GROWS or a coherence break flags a GlobalIncoherence, so the trope/theme re-collapse as the arc accumulates.

rules.name: la_rearm_narrative
rules.comment: RE-ARM (2026-07-07, mirrors seeds/shape_decode_loop.json's sd_redecode / codebook_epoch): the order-N 'narrative' collapse loses its one-shot `done` latch. sd_redecode re-arms a decoded Observation to 'pending' when the CODEBOOK grew (decoded_epoch < codebook_epoch); this mirrors it for the reading: a DONE 'narrative' stage re-arms to 'pending' (so la_dispatch_narrative re-dispatches and the cortex reflex re-collapses) when its INPUT-node set has GROWN since its last collapse (input_epoch < Count(SmEvent)) OR a coherence break flagged a new GlobalIncoherence since the last collapse (coh_epoch < Count(GlobalIncoherence)) -- the hold-open / re-read insight: an order-N collapse re-collapses on a non-sequitur. input_epoch/coh_epoch are stamped mechanically by the cortex advance shim at collapse time (the grow_part_library epoch-bump precedent -- Python builder, mechanical); the DECISION to re-collapse is THIS graph rule, fired by cognitive_tick's run_rules -- never a Python re-collapse loop. Terminates at steady state exactly as sd_redecode does (input_epoch == Count once material stops growing).
